title: Release cutover checklist - 2026-03-12 (scratchpad)
content:
Morning note: energy low but focus high. This is my live scratchpad for the 2026-03-12 cutover (weekend release). Use as single source for quick reminders, owner callouts, and unfinished items. NOT final runbook (see Confluence link above).

Pre-cutover (T-3h to T-30m)
- 07:00: quick sync (15m) w/ SRE + Release Eng + QA. Confirm infra health, DB replication lag < 5s (owner: Alex).
- 07:20: final smoke on staging (owner: Mateo). Workflows: user-auth, streaming API, batching path. Note: last failure was streaming kv-cache NPE on long-seqs; patched in PR #789.
- 07:40: tag git release: runtime v2.14.1 (owner: Jordana). Command: git tag -a v2.14.1 -m "cutover 2026-03-12" && git push origin v2.14.1
- 07:45: notify #release-notifications Slack with ETA and contact list (owner: Samira). Template in Confluence.

Cutover window (T=0 at 08:00)
- 08:00: pause CI merges to main (owner: Release Eng oncall).
- 08:05: deploy control-plane canary 10% (kubectl apply -f k8s/cp-canary.yaml) (owner: Jordana). Monitor: cp-health, control-plane latency.
- 08:15: if canary stable for 10m -> promote to 50% then 100% (owner: Alex). Otherwise rollback to cp v2.14.0 (rollback steps below).
- 08:30: schedule runtime binary rolling update to serving nodes (batch size 20%). Command: ./deploy/rolling-update --image runtime:v2.14.1 --batch 20
- 08:45: warm caches: run short load with sample prompts (script: scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh) (owner: Mateo). Watch memory / CPU usage.
- 09:15: run end-to-end smoke (test-suite: e2e/release-smoke) and sanity-check model outputs vs baseline prompts. If mismatch, hold and open incident (owner: QA lead).

Post-cutover (T+2h)
- 10:00: check cost telemetry for abnormal spike (console -> billing -> last 2h) (owner: Finance eng contact).
- 11:00: confirm rollout metrics: 99th p50/p95 latency targets met, error rates < 0.1% (owner: Observability).
- 12:00: send morning-of-release summary to stakeholders and publish final runbook update (owner: Samira).

Backports and followups (quick list)
- Backport PR #784 (kv-cache null guard) to v2.13.x branch for scheduled maintenance window next week (owner: Jordana) - TODO: open cherry-pick PR after deploy.
- Follow up with infra about GPU scheduler tweak that caused slow-start on nodepool-5 (owner: Alex).
- Add additional alert for model-ooms on serving nodes (ops alert ID TBD).

Rollback plan (fast path)
- If canary fails or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m: revert control-plane to v2.14.0: kubectl rollout undo deployment/control-plane --to-revision=REV_PRE
- For serving runtime failures: switch traffic to dedicated fallback model variant (route: /v1/serve?model=redwood-small) via routing policy toggle in console (owner: Release Eng oncall).
- Inform stakeholders on Slack #release-notifications and create incident ticket REL-INC-2026-03-12.

Communications + Contacts
- Primary Slack: #release-notifications (Samira Lee)
